2998.title: Development CLI receives a package-manager separator
2998.rootCauseOneLine: The development CLI wrapper forwards pnpm's first separator into Commander, which stops option parsing before command flags.
2998.proposedFix: Remove exactly one first package-manager separator in resolveCliExecution and preserve all later separators.
2998.caveats: The direct reproduction used an isolated unreachable local server address and did not use runtime data.
